records.command:
Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'scripts/production-faults.mjs' -Destination '.dip-local/production-frozen/scripts/production-faults.mjs'
Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'scripts/production-cache-race.py' -Destination '.dip-local/production-frozen/scripts/production-cache-race.py'
$productionPython=(Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.dip-local/laya-env/Scripts/python.exe').Path
Set-Location -LiteralPath '.dip-local/production-frozen'
node scripts/production-faults.mjs --protocol
node scripts/production-faults.mjs
& $productionPython scripts/production-cache-race.py --protocol
& $productionPython scripts/production-cache-race.py
